messages:
Anya Patel: Quick sync — rehearsal tomorrow 10am in conference B. Can everyone join?
Jordan Kim: I can make 10-11. I'll bring the slide deck.
Samir Rao: I need to leave at 10:45, can we run the key facilitation flow first?
Liz Chen: I can do AV/mic ops, will test streamer.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll run through the breakouts and A/B facilitation script. Notes: we should have a 'decision by noon' rule.
Olivia Park: Suggest we add a 5-min primer for engineers on rollout constraints.
Anya Patel: Good call — add primer at 10:05. Rehearsal agenda below:
```
10:00 - 10:05 intro + logistics
10:05 - 10:15 5-min tech primer (Olivia)
10:15 - 10:35 facilitation run-through (Anya/Jordan)
10:35 - 10:50 breakout scripts A/B (Kevin)
10:50 - 11:00 parking-lot & decision rules
```
Jordan Kim: Can we rehearse the sticky note capture process? last time it was messy. Also need copy of facilitator prompts.
Liz Chen: AV checklist: mic batteries, laptop HDMI adapter, streamer connection, room lighting. I'll bring spare batteries.
Samir Rao: For breakout A/B: propose grouping by customer persona not team. Makes prioritization easier.
Kevin Ortiz: +1 persona groups. We'll have templates: Prioritize, Risks, Success metrics.
Olivia Park: Quick comms plan: send pre-read with 3 asks + rubric by EOD. Who owns?
Anya Patel: I'll draft pre-read tonight and tag reviewers. Jordan and Olivia please review.
OpsBot: Reminder — conference room reserved 10:00-11:30 (resv# 4821).
Jordan Kim: For facilitator prompts, here's a short snippet: 
```
Prompt: "What's the smallest change that moves metric X by 10%?"
If stuck: "What customer feedback pulls hardest on current roadmap?"
```
Liz Chen: Also test Zoom recording + local backup. Any objections to recording?
Samir Rao: No objection but add NOTE about non-disclosure for customer examples.
Anya Patel: Decision rules proposal: 1) Evidence wins 2) If tied, runway (engineering) breaks tie 3) Executive tie-breaker only for scope > 2 quarters.
Kevin Ortiz: Will build tiny decision board template for the session.
Olivia Park: Can we add 2-min signal checks after each breakout to capture alignment?
Jordan Kim: Great. Let's meet 9:30 quick pre-check for tech. Liz?
Liz Chen: I'll be there at 9:15 to setup.
Anya Patel: Thanks all — agenda + pre-read going out by 6pm. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can join rehearsal.
